<!--
What the change does, and the fault or need it answers.
The conventions are in CONTRIBUTING.md; the checklist below is the part a review asks about.
-->

- [ ] The pull request carries a type label: `bug`, `enhancement` or `documentation`. The program
      and platform labels arrive from the changed paths.
- [ ] `task check` passes, or the commands it runs, listed in
      [Before a pull request](https://github.com/rrgmc/karaokemachine/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#before-a-pull-request).
- [ ] A product decision or a changed requirement has its entry in `docs/decisions/`.
- [ ] A change of technical direction updates the architecture notes in this same pull request.
- [ ] No committed file names a local path, a network address, personal hardware, a person or the
      size of a music collection.
- [ ] Every new fixture is synthetic; no real song file is committed.
- [ ] Each commit's subject states the rule that holds after it, and its body states the fault it
      answers. See [What a commit message says](https://github.com/rrgmc/karaokemachine/blob/master/CONTRIBUTING.md#what-a-commit-message-says).
